package.title: Measuring Ambiguity Attitudes for All (Natural) Events
package.paper_type: Theory + experimental behavioral economics (preference elicitation, time-pressure experiment)

audit.engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) - DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
audit.mode: static audit + internal-consistency reimplementation (no raw data available)

source_material.raw_data_reason: No replication package/data/code is publicly available; Zenodo es-replication-repository search returned 0 hits. This 2018 paper predates Econometrica's mandatory replication-package policy (2019-2020).

notes: Definitions 2.1 (b=1-mc-ms) and 2.2 (a=3(1/3-(mc-ms))) are algebraically internally consistent; neutrality/range calibrations reproduce.
C6 (orthogonality) and C7 (alpha=b/(2a)+1/2) are external results cited to companion paper Baillon et al. (2018b); not derivable within this manuscript.

empirical_track.key_reproduced: All 8 Table III index means recomputed exactly from Supplement Table SC.I matching-probability means (indexes are linear in mc,ms); SE=SD/sqrt(N) holds; Model-1 regression point estimates equal cell means; all N denominators consistent (104,99,198,1584,496,191).
empirical_track.key_uncheckable: Regression SEs/t-stars/Chi2 (IV,V,VI), R2, Spearman rhos, Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney statistics, Table III medians — all require raw per-subject matching-probability data that is not published.
